target_signature: For finite-dimensional real inner-product spaces and L : V ->L E, define P as the orthogonal projection onto (range L)^orthogonal. Prove its idempotence, self-adjointness/symmetry, annihilation of range L, and the exact least-squares residual identity dist(x, range L) = norm(P x). If feasible from available APIs, prove the complementary-rank identity. Provide a named covariance algebra lemma P(P x)=P x; do not state a Gaussian law.
accepted_lemma_signatures: Mathlib orthogonal-projection API may be used; no Moore-Penrose matrix API is assumed.
forbidden_shortcuts: claiming pseudoinverse formula without proving equivalence
expected_artifacts: raw final compile and axiom audit
stop_conditions: missing Mathlib theorem needed for rank or minimization must be recorded exactly; do not weaken target to scalar idempotence
review_request: fresh gpt-6-astra/ultra after author completion; observed runtime UNKNOWN unless supplied
